fieldguide.block.infernalexp.luminous_fu: A mushroom that glows when touched. On contact, it will also make nearby entities glow, attracting attention.
fieldguide.entity.infernalexp.blindsight: A blind, hostile mob with a whiplike tongue. It is the natural predator of Glowsquitos, and anything glowing. It's tongue is stretchy and sturdy, making it an ideal crafting material.
fieldguide.entity.infernalexp.glowsilk_m: A small passive moth. It drops unique dust and silk, perfect for crafting.
fieldguide.entity.infernalexp.glowsquito: A neutral pest of the Glowstone Canyon, the Glowsquito loves sapping energy out of all things glowing, even you. It is fond of Shroomlight Juice, using it to breed.
fieldguide.entity.infernalexp.voline.des: A small, hostile mob that spawns in small groups. As it ravenously consumes magma cubes or fire-resistant mobs, it will become large and slow. When burnt out, feeding them gold may result in unique effects...
fieldguide.entity.infernalexp.warpbeetle: A passive beetle that will teleport away when it senses danger.
